# A shallow update clears needsVdomUpdate beyond its payload's depth

## Context

Found while tracing #21974 (the Workstation's held reconcile flight) from Sophie's witness: a host update merged into a staged container never settles after a depth-1 update of an ancestor.

## The Problem

`VdomLifecycle#getVdomUpdatePayload` clears `needsVdomUpdate` on the flying component and calls `afterSetNeedsVdomUpdate(false, true)`, and `Container#afterSetNeedsVdomUpdate` then clears the flag on every descendant, whatever the payload's depth. A depth-1 update carries none of its descendants, yet a descendant that still owes an update loses the flag that wakes it: the engine's wakes read that flag (`Neo.layout.Base#set` flies only `if (container.needsVdomUpdate)`; `VdomLifecycle` re-checks it at a flight's end). The owed update never runs, and every `promiseUpdate()` merged into it stays pending.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/container/Base.mjs`, `afterSetNeedsVdomUpdate(value, oldValue)`: the depth-blind walk over `items`.
- `src/mixin/VdomLifecycle.mjs`, `getVdomUpdatePayload`: the payload's `updateDepth`, and the merged children it expands.
- `initVnode` renders at depth -1, so its full clear is right.

## The Fix

`Container#afterSetNeedsVdomUpdate(value, oldValue, depth=-1)` clears only the items an update covers: all of them at -1, none at 1, one level less per level down. `getVdomUpdatePayload` passes its depth, and clears the merged children it expands at their own depth.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] An e2e in a real App Worker fails on dev and passes with the fix: after a depth-1 update of a root, a host change merged into a staged container renders, and its promise settles once the container wakes on its flag.
- [ ] A unit arm through real `Container` and `VDomUpdate` instances holds the same, and a deep update still clears the flag of every descendant it renders.

## Out of Scope

An ancestor flight that carries or prunes a staged container without collecting the callbacks merged into it (the deep and sparse paths) stays with #21974. Keeping a covered item's flag while it owes callbacks was tried and broke dock component specs (DockReload and DockLock: 3 failures with it, 17/17 without): the flag is also what a child merges into, so a kept flag with no flight scheduled swallows later updates.
